domain: Finite nonnegative normal costs or zero; no arithmetic subnormals/overflow; missing-map NaN sentinel is preserved as bits and excluded from arithmetic.
starts: Static graph, native task list and scratch allocations are ready; no precomputed search trace is consumed.
includes: Complete native sample list in original order or disjoint native-order chunks
Full heap-driven CSR search and original strict tie/eligibility/update semantics
All device memory waits, external heap spill and completion/drain
excludes: Workload file I/O and golden checking
Compact result readback (reported separately for measured software)
Group merge, interpolation, source/OPIN/minima and routing

evidence_types.cuda: Measured CUDA events enclosing entire complete batch; first event interval includes first-launch/lazy-module gap
evidence_types.functional_rtl: Complete kernel executed by XSim with HLS automatic functional AXI
evidence_types.bounded_rtl: Complete kernel executed by XSim with fixed shared-bank/credit/latency interposer
evidence_types.fpga_time: RTL cycles plus observed post-done drain divided only by timing-clean OOC target frequency

cold_warm: Five fresh processes/configuration, one first call and five subsequent complete E1 batches per process, all search state reset inside every E1; FPGA cache initialization and state reset are included in its transaction.

baseline_coverage.C1: Compact CSR std::priority_queue/OpenMP CPU measured on same worker as G0, 1/2/4/8 workers
baseline_coverage.G0: Basic GPU kernel, 128 threads/CTA and one CTA/real native job for each 3D workload
baseline_coverage.B0: Original multithread-enabled VPR verifies identical final lookahead wire map; no new B0 E1 timing hook in this phase
baseline_coverage.B1: Frozen native flat export supplies full samples and golden; historical flat/pipeline evidence preserved, not used as an unmatched E1 timing denominator
baseline_coverage.B3: Full strict resident kernel; functional/bounded RTL and OOC core implementation

comparison_limit: Beating the strongest measured C1/G0 warm configuration is a necessary checkpoint, not proof of superiority over B0/B1; the checkpoint fails in this round. E2 remains gated by core feasibility.
